overview: The Mustang Report student broadcast featured interviews with Medford High School athletes, staff, and administrators covering varsity sports teams, school routines, eighth-grade open house activities, and a faculty fundraiser.

items.title: Eighth Grade Open House and Student Life
items.summary: Student reporters interviewed gymnastics captain Erica, secretary Mike McLaughlin, freshman Carmen Diorio, and staff member Nick Tucci regarding school activities and advice for prospective students.

items.title: Varsity Sports Team Updates
items.summary: Reporters spoke with varsity basketball, soccer, and baseball players and coaches about off-season training, conditioning routines, and season expectations.

items.title: Morning Announcements Feature
items.summary: Student host Victoria Rasche explained the process and purpose behind broadcasting daily school announcements and event updates.

items.title: Football Team Manager Report
items.summary: Team manager Eric Rapucci discussed his equipment and scheduling duties alongside areas for team focus during game second halves.

items.title: Faculty Flag Football Game Preview
items.summary: Staff members Jason Nascimento and Mr. Jaworski debated game rules and past rivalries while highlighting the event's benefit for the Eric Roselli scholarship fund.
